nodes.npc_text: Welcome to Luminaria! I'm Lyra. What brings you to our enchanted realm?
Marvelous! Luminaria is full of wonders. Would you like to discover the secrets of the ancient forest or the mystical mountains?
You've come to the right place! We have a wonderful community here. Would you like to meet our village elder or join a group of young adventurers?

options.player_text: I'd love to meet the elder.
The young adventurers sound like fun!

nodes.npc_text: The ancient forest is home to the wise trees and the mischievous fey. Be careful, and may the light of Luminaria guide you!

options.player_text: Thank you, Lyra! I'll be careful.

nodes.npc_text: The mystical mountains hold many secrets and dangers. Remember, courage is not the absence of fear, but the judgment that something else is more important.
Our village elder, Edda, is a wise and kind soul. I'm sure you'll learn much from her. Go, and may the wisdom of the ages be with you!

options.player_text: Thank you, Lyra. I'll go meet Edda.

nodes.npc_text: The young adventurers are a lively bunch. I'm sure you'll have a wonderful time with them. Just remember to always look out for one another!

options.player_text: I will, Lyra. Thanks for the advice!
